dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Lesser Slave River Area (NTS 83O/SE) (GIS data, polygon features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 553, Surficial Geology of the Lesser Slave River Area (NTS 83O/SE) (GIS data, polygon features).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Lesser Slave River Area (NTS 83O/SE) (GIS data, polygon features)
